Every Room Is Borrowed · Bewie

Nine tracks. Nine places.

The digital companion to the vinyl record. Explore Every Room Is Borrowed through nine tracks and the places that accompany them.

Support

Need a hand?

For help with Bewie, email us. Include your app version, device model, system version and a description of the problem. Please hide personal information in screenshots.

bewie.app@cazenave.fr

Published by Benoit Cazenave.

Listen and explore.

Choose a track
Tap a numbered pin. The music starts and the map travels to its location.
Open the player
Tap the current track’s pin to open the controls. If it is away from the centre, the map returns to it while playback continues.
Keep listening
Tracks play in order and the album repeats. Pause, resume or change tracks in the player. Lyrics appear on the map while the player is open.
Listen offline
Lossless tracks download from Apple in the background. Once downloaded, they play offline. New map details require an internet connection.
AirPlay
Use the AirPlay button in the player to select an audio output. Playback controls are also available on the Lock Screen and in Control Centre.
Location
Location access is optional. It centres the map at launch; without a usable location, Bewie opens at Notre-Dame de Paris. Change permission in system settings.
Apple Watch
The Watch app includes its own music for offline listening. You can choose tracks and control playback on your watch.
Share a song
In Messages, select a song, optionally add a note and add the video to your message. Review the draft before sending.
